_doc: NPC_AI_SPEC §3.2 / §12 — drive decay rates, per need, per need-profile.
Every need is a SATISFACTION level in 0..1: 1 = fully satisfied, 0 = desperate.
They all decay DOWNWARD, so a consideration reads urgency as (1 - need).
safety 1 = at ease, 0 = afraid. purpose 1 = fulfilled, 0 = idle/useless.
energy 1 = rested. decayPerSec is in GAME seconds (agentManager.now),
and a full day is worldEnv.dayLength = 720s — so 0.0014/s empties a
start is the value a freshly spawned agent begins at.
An archetype profile lists only the needs it overrides; the rest fall
and purpose replaced hygiene/bladder, fun was renamed morale. Numbers
kept from their old slot where the flavor still fits; guard/companion
overrides extended to the two new needs rather than left at defaults,
since 'a hardened professional tolerates everything except what their
job directly demands' was already the shape of the guard profile.
